purpose: Expose eMMC and a serial ACM console through a vendor Linux environment loaded into RAM.
revision_limits: Physical receipt: CM5 Rev 1.0, BCM2712 D0, 4 GiB, nominal 64 GB eMMC; carrier revision unknown.
install_location: Host-side rpiboot input directory; no installation into EmberBSD.
prerequisites: Identify the exact module, carrier BOOT control and USB data connector.
Use the coherent pinned bundle below and verify SHA256 before loading it.
Arrange independent power and USB data according to the carrier specification.
activation_effect: Loads vendor recovery software into RAM and exports raw eMMC; host tools can then write it. This profile requests no storage or EEPROM writes.
recovery_route: Exit and unmount host storage access before power removal. Release BOOT for the normal boot path. A working normal OS is not established by this profile.
